subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 14, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - November 14, 2026**

**Top Development: Announcing XRAID: Declustered Parity RAID for Zoned XFS**

We're excited to announce the addition of XRAID, a declustered parity RAID for zoned XFS, to AcreetionOS. This new feature provides an innovative solution for managing storage on our Linux distribution. XRAID allows for the creation of a redundant and fault-tolerant storage system, ensuring data integrity and availability even in the event of disk failures. This feature is now available in our latest builds, and we encourage users to explore its capabilities and benefits.

**Community News**

* Our community has been actively contributing to the development of AcreetionOS, and we're grateful for their efforts. If you're interested in joining the community, please visit our Discord server at https://discord.acreetionos.org.
* We've also seen an increase in user engagement on our social media channels, with many users sharing their experiences and feedback about AcreetionOS. We appreciate your support and encourage you to continue sharing your thoughts and ideas.

**Practical Tip: Customizing Your AcreetionOS Desktop**

Did you know that you can customize your AcreetionOS desktop to suit your preferences? With our user-friendly interface, you can easily change the theme, wallpaper, and even add custom widgets to your desktop. To get started, simply navigate to the "Settings" menu and select "Appearance." From there, you can explore the various customization options available. Experiment with different settings to find the perfect look and feel for your AcreetionOS experience.

That's all for this week's newsletter. We're committed to keeping you informed about the latest developments in AcreetionOS and the community. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our community!
